summary: The ordered span and its multiplicative closure are new material, but the file re-proves several located lemmas: the rank-one Cartan commutation helpers duplicate `h_mul_e_pow`/`h_mul_f_pow` at n = 1, six private cast wrappers restate `ringChoose_add_intCast_mem_ringChooseSpan`, one theorem re-derives the definition of `kostantForm`, and the bracket-to-commutator translations are a third copy of private lemmas in `Associative.lean`.
